script_text: Saturn conjuncts your Sun this week, Aries - igniting a Fire-fueled test of identity and purpose. Monday-Tuesday see Mars in Leo trine Jupiter in Cancer, boosting confidence and financial prospects especially around noon. Wednesday brings Mercury sextile Uranus in your 3rd House, sparking ideas and an email. Friday Saturn conjuncts your Sun in the 1st House, demanding discipline and a restructure of ambitions. Thursday's Venus-Pluto square eases by evening, allowing honest talks that deepen intimacy. Friday night-Saturday, Moon in your 10th House highlights career recognition and public praise for you. Wednesday is your power day: Mercury sextile Uranus in the 3rd House sparks insight. Friday is toughest: Saturn conjuncts your Sun and squares Mars, causing heaviness and delays. Draft a daily three-step plan each morning; let Saturn ground you and Mars drive action. Follow for daily updates and comment your sign below to keep the conversation going.
